description.from:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

Targeted design/verification dependency, not a new backend implementation. Consume the separate read-only architecture investigation; avoid duplicating its deep work.

Supplied architecture evidence: Papyrus-sweep source a1019e76a23d411883e9d261eb42bda0b8d9911d implements knowledgeQuery vector retrieval plus bounded graph expansion/context packs. Source and extracted text live in S3; SemanticNode/Relation adjacency records are in AppSync/DynamoDB; current vector path uses OpenAI text-embedding-3-small, 1536 dimensions, and S3 Vectors. A legacy Papyrus deployment has a populated active index; that proves neither readiness nor equivalent population for other publications. Observed vector query filters lack an explicit publication/tenant filter, and multitenancy documentation scopes selected CMS models. Existing editor/admin knowledgeQuery therefore cannot be assumed suitable for public Help. Approximate table metadata reported about 10,115 nodes and one edge; audit query scope, metadata freshness, materialization and actual counts before inferring a graph-population failure or useful graph coverage.

Design deliverable and future verification: map existing knowledgeQuery, source/catalog identity, index binding, authorized caller scope, publication/tenant ownership, published state and citation provenance to the Help contract. Provide an explicit authorized-versus-anonymous access matrix and negative cross-publication, cross-tenant, draft/withdrawal and revoked-permission cases. Verify isolation at retrieval, expansion, caches/context packs, snippets and citation links, not merely frontend filtering. Determine how current source versions, withdrawals and permission changes become visible within a documented freshness bound. Audit source extraction, index and graph coverage per intended documentation knowledge base; graph expansion remains conditional on useful verified population, not a requirement to build/populate a new graph for chat.

Resolve whether existing primitives can be safely reused, narrowed or need changes, with evidence and explicit remaining gaps. No guarantee that a global index is safe, no new RAG backend presumption, no public endpoint/auth change, no index/model call, live audit, deployment or implementation is authorized here. The optional Help chat story is blocked on this design/verification work.
